title: ATAM pack
body:
**welcome to ATAM (All These Awesome Moments)**
this modpack is designed to be ultimately fun, with a lot of gamechanging mods inspired by Crazy Craft, as well as Create, Valkyrien skies, Starlance, and Mekanism.
**this modpack has:**
- shaders
- an unhealthy dose of technology (nuclear reactors)
- block-built vehicles that have physics (why not go to space?)
- a wide variety of guns
- cooking
- city building and colonies
- seasons and interesting terrain
- more mobs (including dragons)
- better trees (they even fall better)
- and much more
